title: nodes/<id>.md header, kind rendered
description: A rendered node's header. The JSON object between the --- lines only; the body is outside this schema. The body is its template.

producer.description: Written, and checked against the kind: computed.

label.description: The display name of the node; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the node).

format.description: The text format of the node's text value: plaintext, markdown_block or markdown_inline.

reproducible.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: always true here.

modelDerived.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when the node reads model output, directly or through other values.

runDependent.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when the node reads run.* or a run-dependent value.

profileCarrying.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when the node reads a profile-carrying value.

if.description: A JSON Logic condition for whether the node runs, or null for always.
